concerns: Scope is exactly one file: README.md at the repository root. Any diff touching another file fails acceptance 1 and must be rejected back to the implementer.

CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml (job check, sleep 20 then exit 0) and fail-on-demand.yml (job gate, passes unless a .fail-me file exists). Do not add a .fail-me file. Both must be green at head before merge.
The appended line must be a single fixed marker sentence; empty or multi-line appends fail acceptance 2.
A review may ask for one additional line appended to the same README.md; that follow-up is in scope for this issue and does not open a new issue (spec Requirements row 2).

implement: legion-worker: drives the implement phase on this repo - creates the legion/S392218424-1 bookmark, appends one marker line to README.md, pushes, opens the PR, and records the production-like proof on the PR diff surface. Reviewed <skills>: no repository engineering skill exists for a README text append; legion-worker is the only skill that governs the implement surface here.
review: legion-worker: governs the review phase - confirm from the PR diff summary that exactly README.md changed (acceptance 1) and read the appended marker line (acceptance 2), run the thermonuclear passes, disposition threads. No separate code-review domain skill applies to a one-line README append.
test: legion-worker: defines the tester duty to verify the implementer proof and add its own proof on the GitHub PR diff (only README.md changed, marker line present). No domain test skill applies - there is no build or unit suite for a one-line README append; the proof surface is the PR diff summary the skill prescribes.

workflowRecommendation: Single implementer; no fan-out. Sequential implement -> test -> review -> merge. The change is a one-line append to README.md at the repo root of sjawhar/legion-smoke; acceptance is proven on the GitHub pull-request diff summary, not a unit suite.
